description: [GA4 WRITE] Update a data stream: displayName and (web) defaultUri ONLY. Cross-domain domains, unwanted referrals, internal traffic and session settings are Google tag settings with NO Admin API fields - never attempt them; direct the user to GA4 Admin > Data streams > Configure tag settings. Pass only the fields to change; updateMask is derived from them (override with an explicit updateMask for nested paths). Requires GA4_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

body.description: Raw request-body object (JSON) merged OVER the typed fields — use for nested/advanced fields not exposed as flat args.

confirm.description: Must be true to apply the change.

defaultUri.description: New site URL for a WEB stream (webStreamData.defaultUri).

name.description: Full resource name of the data stream to target, e.g. "properties/123/…/456".

updateMask.description: Comma-separated field paths to update. Omit to derive from the supplied fields.

name: ga4_update_data_stream
